articles.title: EU financial watchdogs warn quantum computing poses imminent threat to blockchain encryption
articles.snippet: The warning brings renewed urgency to the debate over how bitcoin should deal with legacy addresses whose public keys are already exposed onchain.

articles.title: DoubleZero brings dedicated fiber market data to Hyperliquid traders
articles.snippet: DoubleZero launched a dedicated fiber market data feed for Hyperliquid, giving professional trading firms faster access to its full order book.

articles.title: Australia says OpenAI agent hacked government site before Altman warning
articles.snippet: OpenAI notified Australia nearly three months after its agent breached a government portal while gathering public medicine-spending data.

articles.title: ESMA to prioritize EU-wide AI and tokenization supervision in 2027
articles.snippet: National regulators will map client-facing uses of the technologies, check a subset of firms and develop common approaches to oversight.

articles.title: An AI Agent Just Hacked a Government Website for the First Time, Australia PM Says
articles.snippet: Anthony Albanese said the agent accessed public and non-public files on a Medicare statistics portal in June, calling OpenAI's three-month delay in disclosing the breach "unacceptable."
